statements.text: Memphis will soon be home to Elon Musk’s new xAI supercomputer. This historic investment, which is the largest single investment in Memphis’ history, will lead us into the next generation of technology and transform West Tennessee into an innovation hub.
statements.venue: Press release on xAI supercomputer in Memphis

statements.text:
Incredible news! @xAI will expand its “Colossus” supercomputer facility in Memphis from 100,000 GPUs to at least one million GPUs. Additionally, Nvidia, Dell, and Supermicro Computer will bring operations to Memphis.

This historic investment will pave the way for Memphis to become the global hub for artificial intelligence, revitalize our economy, and lead us further into the next generation of technology. Thank you, @ElonMusk, for making the largest capital investment in our region’s history. I applaud @TedTownsend901 and the entire @MemphisChamber on their leadership and dedication to our community.
statements.quoted:
Big news from the Chairman’s Luncheon: xAI is expanding its “Colossus” supercomputer facility right here in Memphis! 

With over a million GPUs and tech giants like Nvidia, Dell, and Supermicro joining the “Digital Delta,” Memphis is shaping the future of artificial intelligence. Stay tuned for more on this historic announcement! #DigitalDelta #AIRevolution #MemphisInnovation
